title: NoMoreAttributes
description: A lightweight plugin to hide, remove, or limit item attributes. Supports Bukkit, Spigot, Paper, Folia (1.17-1.21+).
body:
# 🛡️ NoMoreAttributes ### Take full control of item attributes on your server! [![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/Minecraft-1.17--1.21+-brightgreen?style=flat-square&logo=minecraft)](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nomoreattributes) [![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-16+-ED8B00?style=flat-square&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white)](https://adoptium.net/) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) **Bukkit** • **Spigot** • **Paper** • **Folia** • **Purpur** ---
## 📖 About **NoMoreAttributes** is a lightweight yet powerful plugin that gives you complete control over item attributes. Whether you want to hide annoying tooltips, remove attributes entirely, or set balanced limits — this plugin does it all! Perfect for RPG servers, minigames, vanilla+ experiences, and custom item management. --- ## ✨ Features
🙈 Hide Attributes Hide attribute tooltips from item descriptions. No more cluttered lore! - Hide all or specific attributes - Hide slot information ("When in Main Hand") - Clean, vanilla-like item appearance
🗑️ Remove Attributes Completely remove attributes from items. - Remove on pickup, craft, or inventory interaction - Remove all or only specific attributes - Perfect for vanilla balance
📊 Limit Attribute Values Set minimum and maximum values for each attribute. - Prevent overpowered items - Balance custom items from other plugins - Limit total attributes per item
⚙️ Highly Configurable - Per-world settings - Exclude items by name, material, or CustomModelData - Bypass permission for staff - Debug mode for troubleshooting
--- ## 📋 Commands | Command | Description | Permission | |:--------|:------------|:-----------| | `/nma reload` | Reload configuration | `noattributes.admin` | | `/nma check` | Check held item attributes | `noattributes.check` | | `/nma clean` | Remove all attributes from held item | `noattributes.clean` | | `/nma hide` | Hide attributes on held item | `noattributes.admin` | | `/nma show` | Show attributes on held item | `noattributes.admin` | | `/nma info` | Display plugin information | `noattributes.admin` | | `/nma help` | Show help message | — | **Aliases:** `/nma`, `/noattr`, `/nomoreattributes` --- ## 🔐 Permissions | Permission | Description | Default | |:-----------|:------------|:--------| | `noattributes.admin` | Full access to all commands | OP | | `noattributes.bypass` | Bypass attribute processing | OP | | `noattributes.check` | Use `/nma check` command | OP | | `noattributes.clean` | Use `/nma clean` command | OP | --- ## 📦 Installation 1. **Download** the latest version 2. **Place** the JAR file in your `plugins` folder 3. **Restart** your server 4. **Configure** `plugins/NoMoreAttributes/config.yml` 5. **Apply** changes with `/nma reload` --- ## 🎮 Compatibility ### ✅ Supported Platforms | Platform | Status | |:---------|:-------| | Bukkit | ✅ Supported | | Spigot | ✅ Supported | | Paper | ✅ Supported | | Folia | ✅ Supported | | Purpur | ✅ Supported | | Pufferfish | ✅ Supported | ### ✅ Minecraft Versions | Version | Java Required | |:--------|:--------------| | 1.17 - 1.17.1 | Java 16+ | | 1.18 - 1.20.4 | Java 17+ | | 1.20.5 - 1.21+ | Java 21+ | --- ## 🔧 Use Cases > **🎮 RPG Servers** > Limit attribute values to balance custom items and prevent overpowered gear. > **🌿 Vanilla+ Servers** > Hide vanilla attribute tooltips for cleaner, more immersive items. > **⚔️ Minigame Servers** > Remove all attributes for fair, balanced gameplay. > **🔨 Custom Items** > Clean up items generated by other plugins or datapacks. --- ## 📊 Performance - ⚡ **Lightweight** — Minimal memory footprint - 🚀 **Optimized** — Efficient event handling - 🧵 **Thread-safe** — Folia compatible - 📉 **Low TPS impact** — Won't slow down your server --- ## ❓ FAQ
Does this work with custom items from other plugins? Yes! NoMoreAttributes processes all items regardless of their source. You can also exclude specific items using the exceptions configuration.
Will this break my existing items? If you use `remove-attributes: true`, the attributes will be permanently removed. If you only use `hide-attributes: true`, the attributes remain but are hidden visually.
Does this support 1.21 attribute changes? Yes! The plugin automatically detects your server version and uses the appropriate API (legacy or new 1.21+ API).
